title: Macrophage: Biological Functions, Diseases, and Therapeutic Targets.
snippet: Macrophages are sentinel innate immune cells that arise from embryonic precursors and bone marrow monocytes, displaying a functional continuum that transcends the classical M1 (pro-inflammatory)/M2 (anti-inflammatory) dichotomy.
